comment: The bridge release's own inputs to the testnet package (briefs/tnb-without-host.md). build-bridge-image.py checks every checkout against these commits before it builds; deploy/testnet/pins.json stays the node image's. dnb-tool is built from the package's own bft-core checkout (its commit is recorded in artifacts/bridge-images.json): the lock-proof endpoint ships with the package.
